name: Macy Industries
old_description: In business since 1975, Macy is made up of a hardworking team of knowledgeable metal fabrication experts with quality and integrity in mind. From our family to yours, we appreciate your support and look forward to accommodating your metal fabrication needs.
about:
Macy Industries operates from Hooksett, New Hampshire, where it was founded in 1975 as a family-owned metal fabrication business. The company remains family-run, emphasizing a collaborative approach that spans design, fabrication, and installation.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication services including welding, cutting, machining, and forming of stainless steel, aluminum, galvanized steel, copper, and carbon fiber. Its modern facility produces dust, fume, and mist collection systems; HVAC ductwork; structural steel frames; machine frames; platforms; staircases; architectural panels; and a range of miscellaneous metal products. The team handles projects from engineering design through on-site installation and ongoing maintenance.

Customers span commercial, industrial, and residential sectors. Construction managers, general contractors, and architects specify Macy for metal staircases, railings, balconies, awnings, retractable roofs, and hydraulic doors used in hotels, restaurants, and retail spaces. Facility managers and industrial engineers rely on the company's dust and fume collection systems for production facilities, while residential architects incorporate copper hoods, countertops, and specialty railings into custom homes. The firm also serves architectural millwork shops, plumbing and HVAC contractors, and medical laboratory and commercial kitchen projects.

Macy differentiates itself through a proven collaborative process that integrates design, production, and installation, which the company says keeps clients returning with new projects. It highlights engineering creativity and flexibility to deliver products that are difficult for others to replicate, backed by in-house maintenance on everything it manufactures.

name: Maddox Industrial Transformer
old_description: I have been very happy with the three 15kva transformers we purchased from Maddox. The team is ready to please, friendly and actually helpful. The cost vs quality is unfounded. Shipping for these larger units was surprisingly fast too. We will definitely be doing business with them in the future!
about:
Maddox Industrial Transformer was founded in 2015 by a group of transformer industry veterans led by Camden Spiller in Simpsonville, South Carolina. The company is headquartered in Battle Ground, Washington, and operates seven facilities across the United States, including locations in Greer, Pelham, Fountain Inn, and Woodruff, South Carolina; Batavia, Ohio; Moscow, Idaho; and Houston, Texas.

The company designs, manufactures, supplies, and warranties padmount, substation, polemount, and dry-type transformers built to ANSI, NEMA, DOE, and IEEE standards. It also provides pad-mounted and metal-enclosed switchgear. Maddox maintains a large inventory of new and remanufactured units — ranging from 3 kVA mini power centers to 160,000 kVA substation transformers — and offers repair, rewinding, rental, surplus purchase, and parts services nationwide. With over 400 employees, the company has shipped more than 100,000 transformers.

Maddox serves commercial and industrial customers across data centers, manufacturing, renewables, electrical distribution, bitcoin mining, electrical contractors, and real estate development. Its clients range from family-owned businesses to Fortune 100 companies and global data-center hyperscalers. Case studies reference a lumber mill, irrigation district, city electric utility, and solar project.

The company was started to address long lead times and unresponsive service from traditional utility-focused OEMs. Maddox differentiates itself with a "Fast Pass" model for commercial and industrial projects, offering same-day quotes, stock units that can ship in hours, expedited custom production, and direct access to sales engineers rather than call centers.

name: Magic Solar
old_description: Transform your business, farm or home with the limitless power of solar energy. Magic Solar is Idaho's trusted partner for reliable solar installations built to fit every project. Whether you're a business aiming for environmental responsibility or a homeowner seeking energy independence, our solar energy systems are designed and built to support your needs. We know every solar panel we install contributes to a brighter, greener tomorrow for Boise, Twin Falls, and beyond.
about:
Magic Solar operates from Boise, Idaho, serving the Treasure Valley, Magic Valley, and surrounding communities including Twin Falls. The company provides solar energy installations for commercial, agricultural, and residential properties. While the firm emphasizes over 40 years of combined team experience, a specific founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The installer designs and deploys photovoltaic systems through a six-step process: free on-site estimation, design approval, permitting management, installation, inspections, and system setup with owner training. Services span commercial solar installations that reduce overhead and add backup power, residential systems for energy independence, and ongoing maintenance to protect system performance. The company also guides customers through federal and state incentives such as the Investment Tax Credit, USDA REAP grants, and Idaho-specific tax deductions.

Magic Solar serves businesses seeking environmental responsibility and cost savings, farms and rural enterprises leveraging USDA programs, and homeowners across the Treasure and Magic Valleys. The team coordinates with local utilities and building departments to handle permitting and interconnection paperwork.

The company differentiates itself through its "Our Knowledge Is Your Power" philosophy, backed by six core values — Attitude, Integrity, Character, Vision, Determination, and Safety. Technicians receive weekly safety briefings and advanced construction supervisory training through AGC programs, while foremen hold certificates from AGC's Supervisory Training Program. Community involvement includes partnerships with the Boys and Girls Club, Twin Falls School District Education Foundation, and The Jae Foundation. A related entity, Magic Valley Electric LLC, supports the electrical contracting side of projects.

name: Maine Mold & Machine
old_description: Maine Mold & Machine, Inc. specializes in plastic injection molding. With our molding capabilities, we can do the modification and repair of the molds, part assembly as well as plastic part production - all under one roof.
about:
Maine Mold & Machine, Inc. was founded in 1985 in Hartford, Maine. The company operates from a facility on Town Farm Road and has been providing plastic injection molding services for over three decades; as of 2006 it noted more than 20 years in operation. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in plastic injection molding and offers mold modification and repair, part assembly, and plastic part production all under one roof. It works with materials ranging from basic plastics to highly engineered resins, accommodating production needs from short-run sampling to long-term, high-volume runs.

The company serves a diverse set of industries, including industrial filtration systems, military components, medical devices, fishing equipment, and home gaming products, along with other specialty applications. Its customer base spans the New England region, covering Maine, Vermont, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, and Rhode Island.

Maine Mold & Machine emphasizes its ability to handle the entire molding process in-house, from tooling adjustments to finished assembly, which it positions as a way to streamline production for customers.

about:
Maine Woods Company operates from Portage, Maine, where it has been producing hardwood lumber since its founding in 1841. The company's ownership structure is not publicly disclosed, and no individual founders are named in available materials.

The company runs a state-of-the-art sawmill and dry line, positioning itself as the largest single manufacturer of hard maple lumber in the Northeast. It processes northern hardwoods — hard maple, yellow birch, soft maple, and white ash — into rough dimension stock, surfaced lumber, and specialty items such as bird's‑eye and flame birch. All output carries an FSC® certification guarantee.

Maine Woods Company markets its lumber to discriminating buyers in the region and beyond, though the provided materials do not name specific industries or customers. The firm was featured in the December 2022 issue of National Hardwood Magazine.

Its stated mission — “Running right, running safe to sustainably produce the highest quality hardwood lumber” — reflects a focus on safety and sustainability. The company attributes the superior color and grain of its wood to the colder climate of Maine's northern forests.

about:

The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its leadership includes Vice President Anthony Hobson, graphic designer Curt Zebuhr, embroidery technician Cindy Knock, and marketing and inside sales lead Taylor Zebuhr.

The shop provides screen printing, embroidery, and specialty decoration services, supported by in-house graphic design and custom webstore creation. Screen printing is offered in single-color, multi-color, and special-effect options with access to the full Pantone color system. Embroidery covers polos, jackets, hats, bags, and other corporate wear. The company also maintains an apparel showroom for customers to evaluate garments before ordering.

Customers range from area businesses and educational institutions to sports teams and community organizations. The company emphasizes a local-partner approach, handling projects from concept through finished goods.

Mainstreet Iowa Apparel positions itself on quick turnarounds, competitive pricing, and a relationship-focused model rather than transactional order-taking. Its stated goal is to make the custom-apparel process easy and deliver results customers are proud to wear.

name: Majestic Metals by Fathom Manufacturing
old_description: Majestic Metals was founded in 1979. Across more than 45 years, the company has built an exceptional reputation for service, quality, and speed in sheet metal fabrication.
about:
Majestic Metals was founded in 1979 in Denver, Colorado. For more than 45 years the shop has built a reputation for service, quality, and speed in sheet metal fabrication. Now operating as Majestic Metals by Fathom, the facility continues to serve customers across the Denver region and nationwide from its original location.

The Denver facility provides end-to-end sheet metal fabrication, taking parts from laser cutting and CNC punching through forming, welding, captive hardware installation, finishing, graphics, and final assembly. Equipment includes three fiber and solid-state lasers, two CO2 lasers, five punch presses, thirteen press brakes up to 12 feet and 220 tons, twelve TIG welders, seven MIG welders, and a laser welder. The shop runs lights-out production for quantities of 100 to 10,000 parts and supports projects from prototype through full production.

Core industries include data centers and IT infrastructure, EV charging equipment, medical device housings, self-service kiosks and retail technology, industrial equipment enclosures, military and defense, automotive, energy, agriculture, semiconductor, and consumer electronics and lighting. Customers receive complete fabricated products such as server cabinets, equipment enclosures, control panels, EV charging stations, and analytical equipment.

The company differentiates itself with a single-source model that eliminates multi-vendor friction, a value-engineering approach on every project, design-for-manufacturability support, and a 98% on-time delivery rate. The facility is ISO 9001 certified and ITAR registered, allowing it to handle government and defense work.

name: Manchester Packaging Co
old_description: Founded in 1969, Manchester Packaging Company began business with the goal of providing our customers with quality economical packaging and we continue that tradition today.
about:
Manchester Packaging Company was founded in 1969 in St. James, Missouri, with the goal of providing quality economical packaging. The company remains a custom manufacturer of polyethylene blown film and bags.

The company produces mono-layer and three-layer co-extruded polyethylene film in various slip and clarity grades, including biopolymer blends. It offers flexographic printing from one to eight colors in line or process designs, with both surface and reverse printing options. Finished products include side-seal and bottom-seal bags made to custom sizes, as well as US Postal Service mail overwraps. The facility also recycles 99 percent of its production waste.

Manchester Packaging serves manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, and retail businesses across the packaging sector. Its FDA-approved film is used in applications requiring direct food contact, though specific end markets are not detailed.

The business was started to deliver economical packaging without sacrificing quality, a tradition it says it continues today. Its differentiation rests on in-house extrusion, printing, and converting capabilities that allow custom film and bag constructions within equipment limits.

name: Manufacture Alabama
old_description: is the only trade association in the state dedicated exclusively to the competitive, legislative, regulatory and operational interests and needs of manufacturers and their partner industries and businesses.
about:
Manufacture Alabama operates from Montgomery as the state's sole trade association focused exclusively on the competitive, legislative, regulatory, and operational interests of manufacturers and their partner businesses. The organization represents hundreds of companies ranging from global corporations to small family-owned operations, each described as a vital component of Alabama's economy and job base.

The association provides a suite of services designed to support vibrant manufacturing operations, including environmental, safety, and human resources compliance assistance; government and regulatory representation; workforce development strategies; transportation and infrastructure initiatives; industry promotion; and tax, energy, and other policy support. It also manages member resource groups and industry advisory councils, and operates the Girls Learning About Manufacturing (GLAM) program to encourage female students to pursue manufacturing careers.

Its membership base spans the manufacturing sector broadly, encompassing both manufacturing members and partner members that serve the industry. The association's advocacy and services are directed at the full spectrum of Alabama manufacturers, from large international firms to small local shops.
